_meta.shows: A Duna station whose controller can no longer reach home: its experiments are part-way through and the data they hold has nowhere to go.
_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC. The station is out of contact and overdue, and it was holding unsent data when it went quiet. This is the scene for the state where something is WRONG rather than merely absent: the science bars keep their fill, so a reader has to be able to tell a station that is working from one that is stranded without reading the bars. The last report names the station's own cluster, so the power balance is present, and it carries no send verdict, since a station out of contact has none current. The contact badge, the last-heard time and the unsent figure are what say it is stranded.

_scene.caption: Duna station overdue: the experiments keep their fill, so the state reads off the contact badge, the last-heard time and the unsent data. The experiment name is deliberately long enough to reach the `Truncate`, which is what an operator sees for most real Breaking Ground part names at this tile
